consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if the ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` option is configured; the option must be replaced with `namespaces`.

original.statement: The ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` configuration option was removed in v3; its presence prevents Traefik from starting and must be replaced with the `namespaces` option.

decision.reason: [ev-3faa5287ea4e] says the ConsulCatalog `namespace` option is removed in v3, "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", and gives replacing it with `namespaces` as the fix. The upgraded Traefik refuses to start while an unsupported static option is set, so classing this as upgrade-blocked (unmet precondition) is reasonable, and the action-required class is supported. Critical severity fits because the proxy does not start at all. The statement and remediation match the evidence.
